question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My friend borrowed a large sum from me for investment in stocks but so far he hasn’t had any considerable _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **"profit"**. (मुनाफ़ा)
 
• **"Profit"** refers to the financial gain that is obtained after all expenses and costs have been deducted.
 
 
• **Example**: *She invested wisely and made a profit.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the use of **"profit"** implies the financial gain that the friend was expected to generate from the investment in stocks.
 
• Hence,** "profit"** is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

**Complete Sentence**: "My friend borrowed a large sum from me for investment in stocks but so far he hasn’t had any considerable **profit.__**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sum**: A sum refers to a particular amount of money. (धनराशि)
 
• **Money**: It refers to currency or any other medium of exchange that is used to facilitate transactions, and pay for goods or services. (धन)
 
• **Fund**: A fund refers to a pool of money that is set aside for a specific purpose, such as investment. (पूंजी)
